name: sitesmith
description: One skill for building websites that do not look AI-generated. Routes by mode and stack, then follows init, build and audit before making a release claim.

plugins.name: sitesmith
plugins.description: Design, build, redesign, audit and polish websites and web apps. Names the page it would have made on autopilot and builds a different one, then refuses its own output in a browser: contrast in both colour schemes, reduced motion, and an anti-repeat ledger across builds.
